integrity: Theorem has a self-contained mathematical proof; finite checker is diagnostic, not an infinite proof. Claims of independent review, publication priority, and institutional certification are not made.
scientific_limitations: Finite orthogonal sums of uniformly bounded-below positive unilateral weighted shifts only. No classification of arbitrary bounded-below operators or infinite sums. Realization requires no fixed global bound on weights independent of the target compactum. Literature priority is qualified by inaccessible classical vector summability full text.
title: Every positive compact continuum occurs as a root-cluster set of finite sums of weighted shifts
